phamcuong21478-rtl-skills-varch.description: Decompose an IP requirement into submodules, define interfaces, and generate an architecture document plus per-module requirement files and a top-level skeleton

phamcuong21478-rtl-skills-vdebug.description: Trace failing signals through the RTL hierarchy, classify root cause, and write a debug report per issue — no fix is proposed

phamcuong21478-rtl-skills-vdesign.description: Generate a design proposal, documentation, and RTL backbone from a requirement file

phamcuong21478-rtl-skills-vdoc.description: Aggregate all per-module documentation into a single comprehensive IP document

phamcuong21478-rtl-skills-vexplain.description: Generate documentation for any RTL module from Verilog source files

phamcuong21478-rtl-skills-vfill.description: Implement Verilog code from an approved design proposal, then lint and simulate

phamcuong21478-rtl-skills-vflow.description: Scan project state to determine phase completion, write flow_status.md, and orchestrate the full RTL design flow from architecture to documentation

phamcuong21478-rtl-skills-vsynth.description: Synthesize a Verilog module or full IP with Vivado and report resource utilization, Fmax, and power

phamcuong21478-rtl-skills-vtestgen.description: Scaffold a Makefile-driven, CPU-bus-controlled testbench project for an IP and generate a comprehensive set of self-checking testcases, validate each with make, and write a testcase list

phamcuong21478-rtl-skills-vtestrun.description: Run all IP-level testcases from tc_list.md through the bench Makefile, capture results, and write per-failure issue reports with no fix suggestions
